statusRules.passed: Only when both legacy and ts satisfy every required frame and numeric/discrete/visual threshold.
statusRules.review: Both sides captured successfully; only an explicitly reviewable visual or text threshold is exceeded.
statusRules.failed: A required frame, UI action, deterministic step, screenshot, evidence value, discrete assertion, or numeric threshold fails.
statusRules.capability-missing: A required cross-version UI/test capability is unavailable on either side. This is never passed or skipped.

gateModes.review-collection: Exit non-zero only for failed or capability-missing. A completed visual discrepancy may be reported as review for human triage.
gateModes.strict-gate: Exit non-zero for review, failed, or capability-missing. Only passed exits zero.

prohibitedPassedConditions: One app has no completed F0-F5 frame set.
An action was effected by direct element-state mutation instead of a browser UI event.
A declared action has no observable discrete state or serialized-circuit hash transition at F2.
A required screenshot, diff, target numeric state, or serializedCircuitSha256 is missing.
A fixed-step frame is generated by wall-clock waiting instead of the declared deterministic solver step count.

rules: running must be false at every captured frame.

F0, F1, and F2 have simulationStepCount 0 and numericStatus 'uncomputed' unless the manifest explicitly declares a pre-action solve. Their V/I/P values are diagnostic-only and are not cross-version numeric assertions.

For numericStatus 'uncomputed', every non-topological numeric observable (target volts/current/power and scope sample values) must be serialized as null, never as a synthetic zero. A solver must not report an uncomputed value as a measured 0.
F0 and F1 must preserve target state and serializedCircuitSha256.
F3 must equal F2 plus exactly one deterministic solver step.
F4 must equal F3 plus exactly nine deterministic solver steps (ten after F2 total).
F5 must equal F4 plus exactly ninety deterministic solver steps (one hundred after F2 total), unless the manifest settled predicate is met and its evidence is recorded.
F3, F4, and F5 have numericStatus 'solved'. Target volts/current/power must be finite and are compared across versions.
A hold action requires F2 and F3 evidence while pointerdown is active, then a recorded pointerup before F4.

actionTrace.trustedUiRoute: Must identify Canvas pointer dispatch or a visible browser form control. Probe APIs may locate/observe/step only.

comparison.discrete: Target type and declared expected state must match exactly between apps at every frame.
comparison.uncomputedFramePolicy: Compare topology, target state, action trace, paused state, step count, screenshots, and per-app circuit hashes at F0-F2. Do not compare V/I/P or scope numbers. Do not require legacy and TS serialization hashes to equal each other.
comparison.solvedFramePolicy: At F3-F5 compare every required finite target numeric observable. An absent, null, NaN, Infinity, or mismatched numericStatus is failed, not reviewed.
comparison.scopePolicy: scopeSummary is mandatory evidence but is compared only for channels explicitly declared by the scenario's observation plan. Undeclared app-default scopes are retained for diagnosis and do not change target V/I/P comparison.

visual.defaultDisposition: review unless the scenario-specific visual threshold is supplied

currentKnownAssessment.reason: This note refers to the earlier single-sided smoke report. The first double-sided cap report must still be re-emitted with numericStatus and null uncomputed observables before it can satisfy this contract.
